questions.question_text_en: Ton sells fruit juice for 13 baht per cup. He sells 5 cups. Each cup costs 6 baht to make. First find the total sales, then find the total cost, and subtract to find the profit. What is the profit?
questions.explanation_en: Sales are 13 × 5 = 65 baht. Cost is 6 × 5 = 30 baht. Profit is 35 baht.
